messages.subject: Re: Ubuntu `make` installation problem
parts:
aL3xa,

For ubuntu you can create a file named mod_R.load and place it in
/etc/apache2/mods-available then sym-link it to
/etc/apache2/mods-enabled. In the file you will want to put:

LoadModule R_module /usr/lib/apache2/modules/mod_R.so

As far as configuring your web server, you probably want to place your
configuration info in the file /etc/apache2/sites-enabled/default

Best,

Jeff
